exercises.why: **смыслю** — смы́слить (imperfective): to understand; to be knowledgeable (about), to know something (about). Wiktionary: с- + мы́слить.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.q: Many great thinkers who were unknown while alive became famous after death.
exercises.ru: Многие великие ___, неизвестные при жизни, стали знаменитыми после смерти.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.why: **промысел** — про́мысел: obtainment of resources (usually wild animals, birds, fish); hunting, fishing; small-scale handicraft production (pottery, forging, etc.); (figurative, colloquial) obtainment of something through ill-gotten means; (usually, in the plural) industrial mining enterprise.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: вы́мысел — invention, fiction, fantasy, figment; мы́сленный — mental; смы́слить — to understand; мысли́тель — thinker.
